module_summary: Two-state JK-style Moore FSM: a 1-bit state register goes ON when j=1, OFF when k=1, and out decodes the ON state.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: OFF/ON state register with asynchronous reset to OFF.

anchors.name: j
anchors.why: Moves FSM from OFF to ON.

anchors.name: k
anchors.why: Moves FSM from ON to OFF.

anchors.name: out
anchors.why: Moore output: high in ON state.

groups.name: onoff_fsm
groups.description: Two-state register with j/k next-state logic and output decode.
